title: Add native DPMI AX=0101/0102 DOS block lifecycle
description: The native C callback now allocates configured DOS paragraph blocks but cannot free or resize them. Match the Python runtime by tracking bounded native DOS blocks, using first-fit free extents, implementing AX=0101 selector-checked free and AX=0102 shrink/contiguous-grow, coalescing through interval reuse, and updating descriptor ranges. Keep AX=0100 register behavior unchanged and never infer an arena default. Extend 32-bit C tests for allocate/free/reuse, grow/shrink, adjacent live-block protection, invalid selectors, largest-gap failure, and selector exhaustion.
acceptance: AX=0101 releases only live DOS block selectors and removes their descriptors
AX=0102 resizes an owned block in the configured arena and updates descriptor limit
First-fit allocation reuses freed/shrunk gaps without overlapping live blocks
Insufficient or noncontiguous growth returns AX=8/BX largest gap/CF=1
Native DPMI DOS allocator and existing DOS callback harnesses pass
